Sasha: Heads-up — long-run run on Qwen-MQA shows steady memory growth + paging after rope-scale > 1.5. KV pages fragment instead of coalescing; p95 token latency spikes ~2x. I have a small repro. Anyone seen this ‘accordion collapse’ pattern before?

Omar: Can you paste the minimal repro command and any perf snippets?

Sasha: repro command:```
./bench --model qwen-mqa \n  --context 120000 \n  --batching heuristic=adaptive \n  --rope-scale 1.6 \n  --seed 42
```
short log:```
[evict] slab_count=324 -> 371 (+47)
[kv] page_alloc_fail: attempt_coalesce=false
[kv] pages_fragmented=78 -> 153
latency p95=248ms -> 512ms
```

Jin: Hmm. That page_alloc_fail + attempt_coalesce=false smells like coalesce path not being triggered. We recently added a kernel selection path that falls back to a GQA alignment kernel for very long sequences; maybe layout mismatch. Did you see a kernel switch event?

Sasha: Yes — kernel_switch at ~60k tokens in the trace. Profiler shows wall time dominated by page_sweep and memcpy shortly after.

Lisa: Can you dump KV_PAGE_STATS and slab histogram? Even a tiny sample helps.

Sasha: snippet of slab histogram:```
slab_size=4096 used=312 free_frag=12 last_touch=102s
slab_size=8192 used=98 free_frag=34 last_touch=120s
adjacent_free_blocks=3 coalesce_attempts=2 coalesce_success=0
```
Seems adjacent blocks are present but coalesce_success=0.

Devon: I can run an instrumented build to log coalesce decisions. Also note adaptive batching sometimes groups large variable-length requests which can interleave KV layouts — that can prevent safe coalescing.

perf-bot: perf top => top symbols: kv_page_sweep, memcpy, rope_apply_scale, kernel_switch_handler, batch_group_eval

Omar: Next steps suggestion: 1) run reproducer with ENV COALESCE_STRICT=false to force more aggressive coalescing, 2) run a kernel-pinned test (force MQA-only path) to see if switch is root cause, 3) try conservative batching (max_batch_tokens lower) to avoid interleaving, 4) capture full perf.data and a mem snapshot around the spike.

Sasha: Will run 1 & 3 now and upload traces. Assigning 2 to Devon and 4 to Jin. :thumbsup:

Devon: On it. Quick idea: relax the coalesce timing window — treat near-adjacent free pages as coalescible if last_touch delta < 1s. Will bench locally before sending a patch.

Jin: Also collect a kernel selection timeline: when the runtime flips kernels, log active kernel id + seq_len distribution. If kernel selection causes different page layouts, we may need a runtime policy to avoid switching mid-session for long-context flows.

Sasha: Additional observation — rope scaling appears to shift KV keys such that aliasing happens near slab boundaries (wrap-around). That plus MQA interleaving could create micro-fragments that evade our coalescer. I’ll attach a small trace in the ticket.

infra-bot: Incident created: INV-2026-347912 (kv-accordion-collapse). Dashboards: https://dash.re/INV-2026-347912

Omar: Nice. Keep this thread for quick updates. If Sasha can produce deterministic repro, we’ll triage for a quick runtime patch. Sync tomorrow 10:30 if we have a reliable repro.

Sasha: Will update with logs & perf.data in ~1h. Thanks all.
